scope_note: Admin is desktop-first per Le Cayenne deployment. Mobile/tablet still possible (Branch Manager on iPad). WCAG AA target. 30 Vue subdirectories under resources/js/components/admin/.

positive_patterns.title: CatalogStudioComponent.vue exemplary a11y
positive_patterns.evidence: Heavy use of `:aria-label` with i18n interpolation, `:title` for tooltip semantics, `<button type="button">` over divs. Comment L17 documents iter15 round-7 heal: `:title` attribute exposes full label when CSS clips. Used in catalog-control-plane__metrics group.
positive_patterns.verdict: Reference implementation. Other admin components should mimic.

positive_patterns.title: Admin tables use semantic <thead>/<th>
positive_patterns.evidence: ItemListComponent.vue L177-192 uses `<table>/<thead>/<th>`. Both ItemListComponent and CouponListComponent emit proper table semantics.
positive_patterns.verdict: AA-compliant on column scoping (implicit via thead). Strict AA could add `scope="col"`.

positive_patterns.title: Admin dashboard widgets follow 1:1 endpoint mapping
positive_patterns.evidence: resources/js/components/admin/dashboard/ = 15 widgets; each renders one endpoint payload. Clean visual hierarchy. SlaAlerts, ChannelStats, OrderStatistics, OrderSummary, SalesSummary, CustomerStats, TopCustomers, MostPopular, Featured, AuditTrail, Realtime, LastZReport, StockLowAlerts widgets all separate components.

positive_patterns.title: Composer profile UX modular
positive_patterns.evidence: resources/js/components/admin/items/composer/ = 6 files (ProductComposerEditorComponent, StepEditorComponent, StepPreviewComponent, ComposerStepFormPanel, ComposerStepListSidebar, ComposerTemplatePickerModal, ComposerPublishDiffModal, ComposerVersionConflictBanner).
positive_patterns.verdict: Wizard-style UX with conflict banner + diff modal. Pre-publish review is correct UX pattern.

findings.title: Tax/Currency settings — no aria-label observed
findings.evidence: grep `aria-label\|role=` on settings/Tax/*.vue (TaxComponent, TaxCreateComponent, TaxListComponent) returns 0 matches in any of 3 files. Currency, OrderSetup, KioskSetup likely same pattern (V1 baseline forms generated via legacy template).
findings.impact: Screen-reader users editing tax rates lose form context (no `<label for>` or `aria-labelledby` on dropdowns/inputs). For tax-rate edits this is moderate-severity since Branch Managers are typically sighted.
findings.fix_proposal: Add explicit `<label for>` linkage on Tax/Currency form inputs OR `aria-label` fallback. Pattern from CatalogStudioComponent is reusable.

findings.title: Admin table <th> lacks `scope="col"`
findings.evidence: ItemListComponent.vue + CouponListComponent.vue use `<th class="db-table-head-th">` without `scope="col"` attribute. WCAG AA technically requires implicit scoping from <thead> which is present — so this is strict-AA polish, not failure.
findings.fix_proposal: Bulk-add `scope="col"` to all `db-table-head-th` instances via mass find/replace. Low-risk visual no-op.

findings.title: SmIconDelete/SmIconEdit click targets may lack accessible name
findings.evidence: ItemListComponent.vue L239, L269 — `<SmIconSidebarModalEditComponent @click="edit(item)">` and `<SmIconDeleteComponent @click="destroy(item.id)">` are icon-only. Need to verify inside each component whether they render `<button aria-label>` or just `<i>` with click. If the latter — keyboard-inaccessible.
findings.verdict: Pending verification by reading SmIconDeleteComponent.vue (deferred). Logged as P2.

findings.title: Channel statistics chart label conflation
findings.evidence: DashboardService::channelStatistics() emits chart label `Kiosk/App` — admits the Source::APP=10 / KIOSK conflation. End-user (Branch Manager) reading admin dashboard sees 'Kiosk/App' which is ambiguous for a single-resto V1 (Le Cayenne has no mobile app yet → all `Kiosk/App` are kiosk).
findings.fix_proposal: Rename label to 'Borne' (kiosk in FR) for V1 single-resto since mobile app channel is dormant. When mobile app ships V1.1+, restore 'Kiosk/App' split.
findings.note: UX label change requires session-A coordination (DashboardService dirty).

findings.title: Admin Vue surface has 30+ subdirs — discoverability for new ops
findings.evidence: resources/js/components/admin/ = 30 subdirectories. No README/index of which directory maps to which sub-system. New developer onboarding cost.
findings.fix_proposal: Add CLAUDE.md or AGENTS.md in resources/js/components/admin/ mapping subdirs to sub-systems.

findings.title: Admin dashboard is desktop-first; tablet usage is incidental
findings.evidence: No `md:` / `lg:` responsive prefixes systematically observed. CatalogControlPlane uses `db-` utility classes (legacy bootstrap-ish). Admin is not the mobile target — POS/Kiosk are.
findings.verdict: Acceptable for V1. Branch Manager iPad usage works (no broken layouts observed in past tests).

verdict: GOOD. Admin UX/A11y is in a solid mid-tier state — better than typical Laravel admin scaffolds (because catalog studio + composer + dashboard widgets received explicit a11y attention via prior heal cycles). Settings panels (Tax/Currency/OrderSetup) are the weakest dimension. Channel-stats label conflation is the only metric-clarity gap. No P0.
